query: UPDATE sources AS s SET content = NULL, content_nulled_at = now() WHERE (s.tenant_id, s.id) IN (SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[], $2::uuid[])) AND s.content IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM generation_operation_sources AS g JOIN generation_operations AS o ON (o.tenant_id, o.id) = (g.tenant_id, g.operation_id) WHERE g.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND g.source_id = s.id AND o.finished_at IS NULL) AND ((s.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND s.expires_at <= now()) OR (s.recorded_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $3) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM generation_operation_sources AS g JOIN generation_operations AS o ON (o.tenant_id, o.id) = (g.tenant_id, g.operation_id) WHERE g.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND g.source_id = s.id AND o.finished_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $3))))
